commit.message:
Fix shader errors and outdated profile options (#669)

- settings.glsl: undefine the atmosphere intensity macros before redefining
  them, since redefining a macro with a different value is a compile error
  on stricter drivers
- gbuffers_skytextured, gbuffers_weather: declare rainStrength, which
  atmosphere.glsl now uses
- Colored light shafts need colored shadows, so only use them when
  SHADOW_COLOR is on. Fixes a compile error on ultra with colored shadows off
- Profiles: replace the removed GTAO option with SHADER_AO

Co-authored-by: Jacob Paterson <jacob@structatech.com.au>
